title: ClusterCard
description: Schema for cluster cards produced by the idempotent startup pipeline. Canonical artifact generated from Qdrant codebase_chunks_768, validated, and upserted into Postgres cluster_cards table.

id.description: Cluster ID from Qdrant SOM clustering (e.g., 'cluster_42' or som_cluster value)

centroid_vector.description: Centroid embedding vector from Qdrant. Typical dims: 768 (embeddinggemma). Empty array if vector unavailable.

member_count.description: Number of code chunks in this cluster

member_ids.description: Qdrant point IDs for all members in this cluster

features.description: Feature labels extracted from cluster members

files.description: File paths represented in this cluster

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when cluster card was created
